text: Response: After you win a Power challenge by 4 or more total STR, claim 2 power for your House. Limit 1 per challenge.

name: Support of the Kingdom
text: Response: After you win a Power challenge, choose any gold or influence producing location controlled by an opponent, and take control of that location.

name: Supported by the Smith
text:
Any House except Greyjoy.
Any Phase: Kneel 2 influence or kneel a [Holy] character to choose up to 2 locations with a total printed cost of 2 or less in your discard pile and put them into play.

name: Terminal Schemes
text:
House Baratheon or House Lannister only.
Response: After you win an [Intrigue] challenge by 4 or more total STR, choose and kill a non-House Tyrell character.

name: The Archmaester's Wrath
text: Dominance: Kneel X Maester characters to have each player choose and discard X characters he or she controls from play.

name: The Dragon's Tail
text: Marshalling: Choose 1 opponent. You and that opponent each draw 2 cards.

name: The Feast of the Crows
text: Any Phase: Kneel 3 influence to choose 3 Night's Watch characters. Until the end of the phase, one of those characters gains stealth, the second gains deadly, and the third gains renown.

name: The Hand's Judgement
text: Response: Pay 1 gold to cancel the effects of an event card that has just been played.

name: The Lion's Cunning
text: Challenges: Pay X gold from your gold pool to give X participating [Lannister] characters +X STR until the end of the challenge.

name: The Only Game that Matters
text: Any Phase: Until the end of the challenge, participating characters without an [Intrigue] icon do not count their STR.

name: The Price of War
text: Response: After you win a Military challenge in which you control at least 1 attacking War character, choose and discard from play up to 2 non-limited locations controlled by the losing opponent. (Limit 1 per round.)

name: The Raven's Message
text: Limited Response: After you reveal a Power Struggle plot card, kneel a character with a Power icon to kneel all characters with an Intrigue icon. (Limit 1 Limited Response per round.)

name: The Sword in the Darkness
text: Response: After you win a Military challenge in which at least 1 Night's Watch character participated, draw 2 cards.

name: Too Proud to Bow
text: Dominance: Kneel X influence to discard all neutral characters from play. X is the number of neutral characters in play.

name: True Power
text: House Targaryen only.Response: If an opponent would win a Power challenge against you, cancel the determination of challenge winner. You automatically win the challenge.

name: War of Five Kings
text: Plot: After the dominance phase this round, there is an epic phase in which each player may initiate a single challenge of his or her choice. Instead of the normal claim effects, any player who loses one of these challenges as the defender must select his or her next plot card at random. (Place this card next to your plot deck until the end of the epic phase.)

name: Wars Are Won with Quills
text: Response: After you win an Intrigue challenge by 4 or more total STR, choose a challenge type. Until the end of the phase, the losing opponent cannot attack or defend during that challenge type. Limit 1 per phase.

name: We Light the Way
text:
Play before any challenges have been declared this phase.
Any Phase: Kneel a Maester character to choose a challenge type. Until the end of the phase, your Maester characters do not kneel to attack or defend during challenges of that type.

name: Westeros Bleeds
text: Dominance: Kneel 4 influence to discard all characters from play.

name: When Intrigue Woke...
text: Response: After a Militarychallenge resolves, kneel 1 influence to have the losing player choose 1 participating character and put that character on top of its owner's deck.

name: Whispers from the Hill
text: Response: After a character is killed, move up to 3 power from that character to another character controlled by the same player. Then, draw 1 card.

name: Winter Reserves
text:
Play only if it is Winter.
Any phase: Play if you have lost a challenge this phase. Pay 1 gold to put Winter Reserves into play from your hand as an Army character with 4 STR, a [Military], an [Intrigue], a [Power] icon, and deadly.

name: Wolf Dreams
text: Marshalling: Search your deck for 1 Direwolf card, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Yoren's Task
text: Any Phase: Discard 1 Night's Watch character from play to search your deck for 1 different Night's Watch character, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Shadow Politics
text: Response: After Shadow Politics comes out of Shadows, choose a player. That player may initiate an additional Intrigue challenge against an opponent of his or her choice as a standard player action this phase.

name: Neutral Faction
text: You have no House affiliation. Reduce the gold penalty on out of House character cards you play from your hand or place during setup by 1.

name: Flea Bottom
text:
No attachments.
Marshalling: Kneel Flea Bottom to lower the cost of the next character you play this phase by 2. That character comes into play knelt.

name: Ocean Road
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Marshalling: Kneel Ocean Road to lower the cost of the next character with a [Noble] or [War] crest you play this phase by 1.

name: River Row
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
River Row comes into play knelt.
Marshalling: Kneel River Row to lower the cost of the next character you play this phase by 1.

name: Shadowblack Lane
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Marshalling: Kneel Shadowblack Lane to lower the cost of the next character with an Intrigue icon you play this phase by 1.

name: Shivering Sea
text: Marshalling: Discard Shivering Sea from play to reduce the cost of the next neutral character you play this phase by 1.

name: Street of Silk
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
After you play Street of Silk, choose and discard one of your locations from play (cannot be saved).
Marshalling: Kneel Street of Silk to lower the cost of the next unique character you play this phase by 2.

name: Street of Sisters
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Marshalling: Kneel Street of Sisters to lower the cost of the next character with a Power icon you play this phase by 1.

name: Street of Steel
text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Marshalling: Kneel Street of Steel to lower the cost of the next character with a Military icon you play this phase by 1.

name: Street of Steel
text:
Limit 1 per deck. 
Marshalling: Kneel Street of Steel to lower the cost of the next character with a Military icon you play this phase by 1.

name: The Gift
text: Marshalling: Kneel The Gift to reduce the cost of the next Night's Watch character you play this phase by 1. Then, if there is an Epic Battle card next to your plot deck, draw a card.

name: The Isle of Ravens
text: Response: After a Chain attachment leaves play, kneel The Isle of Ravens to return that card to its owner's hand instead.

name: The Land Beyond the Wall
text: Marshalling: Kneel The Land Beyond the Wall to reduce the cost of the next Wildling character you play this phase by 1. Then, if there is an Epic Battle card next to your plot deck, draw a card.

name: The Neck
text: Marshalling: Kneel The Neck to reduce the cost of the next Clansman or neutral Creature character you play this phase by 1. Then, if there is an Epic Battle card next to your plot deck, draw a card.

name: The Roseroad
text:
Limited.
[+1 Income]

name: The Searoad
text:
Limited.
[+1 Income]

name: Twilight Market
text:
Limited.
Marshalling: Kneel Twilight Market to reduce the cost of the next card you play from your hand into Shadows this phase by 1.

name: Dagger Lake Galley
text: Any Phase: Kneel Dagger Lake Galley to choose a unique character you control. That character gains a [Naval] enhancement on the icon of your choice until the end of the phase.

name: Frostfang Peaks
text: Response: After you reveal a plot card, discard the top card of each opponent's deck. (Discard the top 2 cards instead if it is Winter.)

name: Hollow Hill
text:
If you have no power on your House card, reduce the gold penalty on all characters you play from your hand by 1.
Response: After you play a character with an affiliation that does not match any other card you control (including your House card), draw 1 card.

name: Isle of Faces
text: Unique characters you control count their STR toward dominance while knelt.

name: Stoney Sept
text: Any Phase: Kneel Stoney Sept to choose and return 1 Brotherhood character you control to its owner's hand.

name: The Inn of the Kneeling Man
text: Response: After a character with STR 2 or lower is knelt, kneel The Inn of the Kneeling Man to stand that character. Use this effect only if it is Summer or Winter. (Limit once per phase.)

name: The Kingsroad
text:
After you win a challenge, kneel all copies of The Kingsroad in play to choose an opponent. Then, if it is Winter, that player must discard 1 card at random from his or her hand.
[+1 Initiative]
[+1 Income]

name: The Kingsroad
text:
After you win a challenge, kneel all copies of The Kingsroad in play. Then, if it is Summer, draw 1 card.
[+1 Initiative]
[+1 Income]

name: The Red Keep
text:
No attachments.
If The Red Keep would leave play, it goes into Shadows instead of going to its owner's hand, deck, discard, or dead pile.
[+3 Influence]

name: The Shadow Tower
text: Challenges: Kneel The Shadow Tower to add 2 to your total STR during any challenge in which you control at least 1 participating Night's Watch character.

name: Vale Rookery
text: Response: After an opponent wins dominance, discard Vale Rookery from play (cannot be saved) and pay 1 gold to reveal a new plot card.

name: Castle Black
text: Response: After you play a Night's Watch character from your hand, reduce the cost of the next Night's Watch character you play this phase by 1.

name: Craster's Keep
text: Response: After you play a Wildling character from your hand, reduce the cost of the next Wildling you play this phase by 1.

name: Crossroads
text:
[+1 Income]
[+1 Influence]

name: Den of the Wolf
text: Characters lose all immunities. Any Phase: If it is not the marshalling phase, kneel 3 influence and discard Den of the Wolf from play (cannot be saved) to repeat the current phase at the end of the phase. (Limit once per game.)

name: Harrenhal
text:
House Stark only.
Response: After a character is killed, kneel Harrenhal to search the top 3 cards of your deck for 1 card and put it into your hand. Then shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

name: Heart of the Kingdom
text: Challenges: Kneel a Kingdom location to choose a participating character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +1 STR.

name: High Ground
text: Challenges: Kneel High Ground to choose and stand an in-House Army character.

name: King's Landing
text: After a card comes out of Shadows, stand King's Landing. Any Phase: Kneel King's Landing to draw a card. Use this ability only if you control more King's Landing locations than each opponent.

name: King's Pavillion
text: Each character gets +3 STR while it is standing.

name: The Citadel of Oldtown
text: Response: Kneel The Citadel of Oldtown to save a Maester character from being killed or discarded from play, then return that character and all of its Chain attachments to their owners' hands.

name: The Tower of Joy
text: Response: After you win a challenge with fewer participating characters than your opponent, kneel The Tower of Joy to choose and kill a character controlled by the losing opponent.

name: Beyond the Wall
text: Wildling characters you control do not kneel to attack, and cannot defend.

name: Training Grounds
text: Your Army characters do not kneel to attack during Military challenges.

name: The Wall
text: Challenges: Put 1 Night's Watch character into play from your hand, knelt as a defender, during any challenge declared against you. (Limit once per challenge.) Return that character to your hand at the end of the phase if it is still in play."

name: A City Besieged
text: When revealed, choose and discard from play 1 location with printed cost X or lower controlled by each player, if able. X is the number of City plots in your used pile.

name: A Song of Summer
text: While it is Summer, your characters get +1 STR.

name: A Time for Ravens
text: When revealed, search your deck for a Raven card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Above the Sorrows
text: When revealed, discard the top card of each opponent's deck. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: Alliance
text: You may play cards from other Houses without paying a gold penalty.

name: An Empty Throne
text: Each player may initiate an additional Power challenge this round.

name: Assault on King's Landing
text: Characters and locations cannot be saved.

name: At the Gates
text: When revealed, if you have no City plot cards in your used pile, search your deck for a neutral or in-House Maester character of printed cost 3 or lower, and put it into play. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: At the Palace of Sorrows
text: When revealed, each player chooses a card in play which he or she controls and puts the chosen card on top of its owner's deck. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: At the Wall
text: You are considered to be running one additional The North agenda.

name: Attack from the Sea
text: When revealed, kneel all locations.

name: Battle of Oxcross
text: At the end of the challenge phase, each player who has not won a Military challenge must choose and kill 1 character he or she controls.

name: Before the Black Walls
text: When revealed, name a challenge type. In order to declare any characters to attack or defend during challenges of that type, a player must declare all of his or her eligible characters. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: Befouled River
text: When revealed, the player with the most cards at his or her command must choose and discard 2 cards that are under his or her command.

name: Betrayal at the Wall
text:
Increase the size of your plot deck by 1. (Limit 1 per plot deck.)
When revealed, choose and reveal a new plot card if you control 2 or more Night's Watch or Wildling characters. (Cannot be canceled.)

name: Blockade
text: The income on each opponent's revealed plot card is reduced to 0.

name: Breaking and Entering
text: Any attachment or location card that would be discarded from any player's hand as part of the claim of an [Intrigue] challenge may be put into play by the winner of the challenge, under his or her control.

name: Building Season
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then, you and that opponent must each search your decks for a location, reveal it, and put it into your hands. Then, shuffle your decks.

name: Bungled Orders
text: After a player loses a challenge, that player must reveal a new plot card.

name: Burning Bridges
text: Players cannot trigger abilities on character, location, and attachment cards in play.

name: Called to Court
text: When revealed, each player may put an in-House character of printed cost 3 or lower into play from his or her hand. Each player must choose 1 character he or she controls and return it to its owner's hand, if able.

name: Calm Before the Storm
text: Characters and locations are immune to events this round.

name: Calm Over Westeros
text: In order to play an event card, a player must give an opponent one gold token from his or her gold pool.

name: City of Lies
text: When revealed, you may put up to 2 cards with the Shadow crest into Shadows from your hand without paying any costs.

name: City of Secrets
text: When revealed, shuffle the top X cards of your discard pile back into your deck. X is the number of City plots in your used pile.

name: City of Sin
text: When revealed, choose and kneel up to X characters. X is the number of City plots in your used pile.

name: City of Soldiers
text: When revealed, choose and kill a character with STR X or lower. X is the number of City plot cards in your used pile.

name: City of Spiders
text: When revealed, you may trigger the "when revealed" effect of any City plot card in your used pile.

name: City of Spies
text: When revealed, look at the top X cards of any player's deck, discard one of those cards, and put the rest on top of that deck in any order. X is the number of City plots in your used pile.

name: Common Cause
text: Prized 1. X is equal to the number of different House affiliations among the characters you control. (Each character cannot contribute more than 1 House affiliation to this count.)

name: Condemned by the Realm
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then, that opponent must choose and kill a character he or she does not control, if able.

name: Counting Favors
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then, you and that opponent each draw three cards.

name: Crossing the Mummer's Ford
text: When revealed, reveal the top X cards of your deck and add them to your hand. X is the number of River plot cards in your used pile. This effect cannot be triggered by other card effects.

name: Crossing the Ruby Ford
text: When revealed, each opponent must discard 1 power from a card he or she controls, if able. Then, if this your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect on the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: Desolate Passage
text: Each player cannot declare more than 1 attacker or defender in each challenge.

name: Drunken Allegations
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then, you and that opponent must each choose and kneel a standing character.

name: Dry Season
text: Treat all non-unique locations as if their printed text boxes were blank.

name: Family, Duty, Honor
text: When revealed, search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of House Tully cards, reveal them, and add them to your hand. Then, shuffle the other searched cards back into your deck.

name: Fear of Winter
text: Each player cannot play or put into play more than 1 card from his or her hand until you reveal a new plot card.

name: Feast or Famine
text: When revealed, you may choose to add +6 gold to your income this marshalling phase. If you do, you cannot initiate challenges this round.

name: Fleeing to the Wall
text: When revealed, each player chooses up to 3 locations. All locations not chosen are discarded from play (cannot be saved) (cannot be canceled).

name: Focused Offense
text: You cannot declare more than 1 challenge. You cannot declare defenders. This plot's text cannot be blanked.

name: Forging the Chain
text: After you play a Chain attachment from your hand or put one into play from your Agenda, you may put another Chain attachment into play from your hand or discard pile.

name: Forgotten Plans
text: Treat all plots with a name other than Forgotten Plans as if their text box were blank during every phase except the plot phase.

name: Fortified Position
text: Treat all characters in play as though their printed text boxes were blank (except for Traits). Limit 1 per plot deck.

name: Frey Hospitality
text: After a player loses an [Intrigue] challenge, that player must choose and kill a character under his or her control.

name: Game of Thrones
text: Characters you control do not kneel to attack or defend during [Intrigue] challenges.

name: Good for the Gander
text: When revealed, copy the "when revealed" ability of an opponent's revealed plot card.

name: Herding the Masses
text: Non-unique characters cannot be declared as defenders.

name: Holding the Trident
text: While you control fewer characters than any opponent, each character you control gets +2 STR.

name: I Fight to Win
text: If you have more than 1 opponent, after each player has selected a Title, you may select a second Title from the remaining Titles and use both Titles this round.

name: Into the Lists
text: When revealed, each player may choose and kneel 1 non-Army character with a Military icon he or she controls. The character with the highest STR knelt in this way claims 2 power.

name: King's Landing Coup
text: If you have no other City plots in your used pile, reveal the top card of your deck and add it to your hand every time you win a challenge as the defender.

name: Lead by Example
text: Players must declare 2 or more characters to attack or defend in a challenge.

name: Let My Porridge Fly
text: After you win an Intrigue challenge, choose and discard 1 attachment from play.

name: Lineage and Legacy
text: A player cannot initiate a Military challenge unless he or she has won a Power challenge that phase.

name: Loyalty Money Can Buy
text: The claim value on each opponents' revealed plot card is lowered by 1 while that opponent is attacking you.

name: Manning the City Walls
text: When revealed, if you have no City plots in your used pile, put an in-House Army character into play from your hand.

name: Many Powers Long Asleep
text: When revealed, put a Holy character into play from your dead pile.

name: Marched to the Wall
text: When revealed, each player chooses and discards 1 of his or her characters from play (cannot be saved).

name: Men of Duty
text: Unique characters you control get +1 STR and a [Military], an [Intrigue], and a [Power] icon during the first challenge initiated this round.

name: Men of Honor
text: Unique characters gain renown during the first challenge initiated each phase.

name: Men of Pride
text: Non-unique characters lose all keywords.

name: Muster the Realm
text: Players cannot initiate Military challenges unless they control an Army character

name: Mutual Blackmail
text: When revealed, if you have more than one opponent, choose an opponent. You and that opponent cannot declare Intrigue challenges against one another this round.

name: Mutual Cause
text: When revealed, if you have more than one opponent, choose an opponent. You and that opponent cannot declare Power challenges against one another this round.

name: Mutual Enemies
text: When revealed, if you have more than one opponent, choose an opponent. You and that opponent cannot declare Military challenges against one another this round.

name: Naval Reinforcements
text: When revealed, if you are running the Black Sails agenda, reveal 1 character from The Hold and add it to your hand.

name: Naval Superiority
text: Raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 2 during challenges in which you have declared a [Naval] attacker.

name: Negotiations at the Great Sept
text: If you have no other City plots in your used pile, choose an opponent. You and that opponent may each choose to shuffle your hands of at least 1 card into your decks, and replace them with the top 5 cards of the same deck.

name: Noose and Swordpoint
text: Characters with STR 2 or lower cannot stand during the standing phase.

name: On Dagger Lake
text: When revealed, each opponent chooses and discards 1 card from his or her hand, if able. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: On My Oath
text: When revealed, put a Kingsguard or Queensguard character with the [Shadows] crest into shadows from your dead or discard pile.

name: Outwit
text: Response: Kneel a Learned character to cancel the "when revealed" effects of a plot card just revealed.

name: Planning Ahead
text: Skip the taxation phase this round.

name: Power and Wealth
text: Each character you control gets +1 STR for each attachment on it.

name: Pulled from the Rhoyne
text: When revealed, each player returns the top character in his or her dead pile to the top of his or her deck. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: Rains of Autumn
text: Characters, locations, and attachments do not provide income bonuses this round.

name: Rally Cry
text: When revealed, choose and discard 1 character or location with cost X or lower controlled by the player with the most cards at his or her command. X is the combined number of plots in all players' used piles.

name: Redwyne Straits
text: When revealed, the player with the fewest cards at his or her command adds 4 gold to his or her gold pool.

name: Regroup
text: When revealed, place the top card of your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Relentless Persecution
text: When revealed, kneel all non-unique characters in play.

name: Retaliation!
text: If you win initiative, you must choose an opponent as the first player.

name: Rise of the Kraken
text:
House Greyjoy only.
You claim an additional power for winning unopposed challenges.

name: Rule by Decree
text: Cannot be cancelled. When revealed, the player with the most cards in hand chooses and discards cards from his hand until he has 4 cards in hand.

name: Schemes of the Scholar
text: Learned characters you control do not kneel to attack or defend during Intrigue challenges. Raise your claim value by 1 during Intrigue challenges you initiate.

name: Search and Detain
text: When revealed, choose a card without any attachments controlled by the first player. Return that card to its owner's hand (cannot be saved).

name: Seizing the Prize
text: When you claim power for the prized keyword, claim 1 additional power.

name: Shadows and Spiders
text: A player cannot declare a [Military] or [Power] challenge unless he or she has won an [Intrigue] challenge that phase.

name: Shores of Ny Sar
text: When revealed, reveal the top card of your deck and put it into your hand. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect of the top River plot card in your used pile.

name: Siege of Riverrun
text: You cannot declare Intrigue challenges.

name: Snowed Under
text: At the beginning of the standing phase, choose one kneeling character or location controlled by each player. Return all chosen cards to their owner's hands.

name: Spending the Winter Stores
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then you and that opponent each search your decks for an in-House attachment card, reveal it, and put it into your hands. Then shuffle your decks.

name: Stay of Execution
text: If a King or Queen character would be killed, instead return it to its owner's hand.

name: Stoic Resolve
text: Knelt characters cannot be killed.

name: Storm of Swords
text: You may initiate an additional Military challenge during the challenge phase.

name: Summoned by the Conclave
text: When revealed, each player not running an agenda may search his or her deck for a character card, reveal it, and add it to his or her hand. Shuffle all searched decks.

name: Summoning Season
text: When revealed, choose an opponent. Then, you and that opponent must each search your decks for a character, reveal it, and put it into your hands. Then, shuffle your decks.

name: Take Them by Surprise
text: If you lose initiative, discard your hand.

name: The Art of Seduction
text: When revealed, choose 1 opponent that did not reveal The Art of Seduction as his or her plot. That opponent cannot reveal a new plot card during the plot phase next round.

name: The Breaking of Oaths
text: Each player may initiate an additional Intrigue challenge this round.

name: The First Snow of Winter
text: When the first challenge is initiated this round, return all characters with printed cost 2 or lower to their owners' hands.

name: The Grand Melee
text: During challenges, total attacking STR is determined by counting the number of participating attackers and total defending STR is determined by counting the number of participating defenders.

name: The King's Law
text: At the end of the marshalling phase, discard all cards in Shadows.

name: The Lost Message
text: Prized 1. When revealed, choose and discard an attachment from play.

name: The Pale Mare
text: When revealed, each player chooses 1 non-unique character he or she controls. All non-unique characters not chosen are discarded from play.

name: The Power of Arms
text:
You may have up to 2 copies of The Power of Arms in your plot deck.
[War] characters you control get +2 STR.

name: The Power of Blood
text:
You may have up to 2 copies of The Power of Blood in your plot deck.
[Noble] characters cannot be killed.

name: The Power of Faith
text:
You may have up to 2 copies of The Power of Faith in your plot deck.
[Holy] characters you control gain a [Military] icon and do not kneel to attack.

name: The Prince That Was Promised
text: Any character with more attachments than each other character in play does not kneel to attack or defend.

name: The Promise of Victory
text: After you win an Intrigue challenge, you may put all cards in your hand on the bottom of your deck and replace them with an equal number of cards from the top of your deck.

name: The Raven's Song
text: Any effect that would make it Summer or Winter is considered inactive while The Raven's Song is revealed.

name: The Red Wedding
text: When revealed, the opponent to your left chooses 1 Lord and 1 Lady character, if able. Then, you must choose and kill 1 of those characters. The other claims 2 power.

name: The Songs of Bael the Bard
text: When revealed, choose 1 non-Noble character. That character gains 1 Trait of your choice until you reveal a new plot card.

name: The Tides of War
text: After you win a challenge and it is Summer or Winter, choose and reveal a new plot card.

name: The Winds of Winter
text: While it is Winter, opponent's characters get -1 STR.

name: Threat from the East
text:
When revealed, you choose one:
-Each player draws 3 cards. Each player that drew 3 cards discards 3 random cards from hand.
-Each player discards 3 random cards from hand. Each player that discarded 3 cards draws 3 cards.

name: Threat from the North
text: All characters get -1 STR and are discarded from play (cannot be saved) if their STR is 0.

name: To the Spears!
text:
House Martell only.
Characters you control do not kneel to attack this round.

name: Torrhen's Square
text: If you have no other City plots in your used pile, raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 1 during [Military] challenges.

name: Tourney for the Hand
text: Each of your Knight characters gets +1 STR and is immune to opponent's character abilities.

name: Twist of Fate
text: When a player wins a challenge against you as the attacker, he or she may choose to use the claim effect of any challenge type instead of the normal claim effect. This text box cannot be blanked.

name: Unconventional Warfare
text: Any Phase: Pay 1 gold to give Unconventional Warfare the Military Battle, Power Struggle or Intrigue Gambit trait until the end of the phase.

name: Under the Bridge of Dream
text: When revealed, add 2 gold from the treasury to your gold pool. Then, if this is your revealed plot card, trigger the "when revealed" effect on any River plot card in your used pile.

name: Uneasy Truce
text: In order to initiate a Military challenge, an attacker must give the defender 2 gold tokens from his or her gold pool.

name: Valar Dohaeris
text: At the end of the dominance phase, discard all standing characters from play (cannot be saved).

name: Valar Morghulis
text:
Limit 1 per plot deck.

name: The Blackfish
text:
House Stark only. Renown.
While The Blackfish has 3 or more power, your House Tully characters do not kneel to attack.

name: The Blackfish
text:
Prized 2. Renown.
While The Blackfish is attacking, each character that dies for [Military] claim gains "prized 1."

name: Winterfell Honor Guard
text:
House Stark only. No attachments.
Challenges: You may put Winterfell Honor Guard into play from your hand, under the control of any opponent. After that opponent wins a challenge in which Winterfell Honor Guard participated, take control of Winterfell Honor Guard.

name: Jaqen H'ghar
keywords: Ambush. Stalwart. Intimidate. Infamy. Vigilant. Vengeful.
text: Any phase: Bring Jaqen H'ghar out of Shadows by paying the rest of his cost to choose 1 non-Army character in an opponent's dead pile that was killed this phase, and attach it to Jaqen H'ghar as a duplicate. Jaqen H'ghar gains the printed text, base STR, icons, traits and crests of that card. If that duplicate leaves play, return Jaqen H'ghar to Shadows.

name: King Robb's Companions
text:
Renown. No attachments.
During the marshalling phase, you may pay any amount of King Robb's Companions' cost by kneeling that amount of influence.

name: Littlefinger
text:
Stealth. No Condition attachments.
Littlefinger does not kneel to attack. Reduce the cost to play Littlefinger by 1 for each card in Shadows.

name: Edmure's Host
text:
No attachments. Immune to events.
Lower the cost to play Edmure's Host by 1 for each House Tully character you control.

name: Wolves of the North
text:
Deadly. No attachments.
Reduce the cost to play Wolves of the North by 1 for each The North agenda you are running.

name: Fleet from Wolf's Den
text:
No attachments. Renown.
Lower the cost to play Fleet from Wolf's Den by 3 if any opponent is running an agenda.
Response: After Fleet from Wolf's Den is declared as a [Naval] attacker, choose another attacking character you control. Stand and remove that character from the challenge.

name: The Bastard's Boys
text:
No attachments. Lower the cost to play The Bastard's Boys by 1 for each House Bolton character you control.
Response: After The Bastard's Boys are knelt as an attacker and the defending player controls no House Bolton characters, raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 1 (to a maximum of 3) until the end of the phase.

name: War Host of the North
text: No attachments.

text:
No attachments except Siege.

name: A United Cause
text:
House Stark or House Baratheon only.
Play only if you have more than 1 opponent.
Dominance: Discard 1 power from your House card to (choose one): return a character with printed cost 3 or less from your dead pile to your hand, or search the top 4 cards of your deck for a card, put it into your hand and then shuffle the rest back into your deck. (Limit 1 per phase.)

name: Bound by Duty
text: Challenges: Choose a kneeling House Stark character. Until the end of the phase, that character is eligible, while kneeling, to be declared as a defender for any challenge in which it could normally participate.

name: Bran the Builder's Legacy
text:
House Stark only.
Dominance: Pay 3 gold to search your deck for a location card with printed cost 2 or lower, and put that card into play. Then shuffle your deck.

name: Call of the Three-Eyed Crow
text:
House Stark only.
Response: After a unique non-Army character you own enters your dead pile, put that character into play knelt under your control.

name: Compelled by the North
text:
House Stark only.

name: Direct Assault

House Stark or House Baratheon only.

name: Endless Endurance
text:
Challenges: Choose 1 of your participating House Stark characters to get +2 STR until the end of the challenge.
Response: After you win a Military challenge by 4 or more total STR, return Endless Endurance from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Fear Cuts Deeper than Swords
text: Response: Cancel the effects of an event card just played if one of your House Stark characters is chosen as the only target.

House Stark only. Prized 2.

text:

text: Any Phase: Kneel Winterfell Kennels and pay 1 gold to search your deck for a Direwolf card, reveal that card to all players, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

House Stark only.

name: Bear Island
text:
House Stark only.
Dominance: Kneel Bear Island to choose and kill a non-House Stark character without attachments. Use this ability only if every card you control has the House Stark affiliation.

text:
No attachments.
Marshalling: Kneel Gates of Winterfell to reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a House Stark character, put it into play knelt. Otherwise, discard it.

text:
Prized 2.
If Harrenhal has 3 or more gold tokens on it, discard it from play (cannot be saved).

text:
House Targaryen only.
Response: After a character is declared as an attacker or defender, kneel Meereen Tourney Grounds to give that character -1 STR until the end of the phase. (-3 STR instead if you control more unique characters than each opponent.)

name: Meereenese Brothel
text: Response: After a character's STR is lowered by a card effect, kneel Meereenese Brothel to choose and discard an attachment from play.

name: Meereenese Fighting Pit
text: Challenges: Kneel Meereenese Fighting Pit to choose and stand a Dragon character or a character with 1 or more Weapon attachments.

name: Myrish Villa
text:
Any Phase: Kneel 1 influence to put Myrish Villa into play from your hand.
Marshalling: Kneel Myrish Villa to lower the cost of the next Targaryen card you play this phase by 1 (by 2 instead if it is Summer).

name: Plaza of Purification
text: During the marshalling phase, you may pay any amount of the gold cost of Army characters using influence instead.

name: Qarth
text: Challenges: Kneel Qarth to choose 1 Dragon character you control. For the duration of the phase, that character gains an Intrigue icon and Deadly.

name: Qartheen Rookery
text:
House Targaryen only.
Response: After you win a Power challenge by 4 or more total STR, kneel and discard Qartheen Rookery from play (cannot be saved) and pay 1 gold to reveal a new plot card.

name: Vhagar
text: Response: After a character enters play under your control, kneel Vhagar and kneel 1 influence to attach the topmost attachment in your discard pile to that character, if able.

name: Visenya's Hill
text: Any Phase: Kneel Visenya's Hill to choose 1 character card in any discard pile, and move that card to its owner's dead pile.

name: Yunkai
text: Challenges: Kneel Yunkai to choose 1 Dragon character you control. Until the end of the phase, that character gains Renown.

name: Balerion
text: Any Phase: Kneel Balerion to lower the cost of the next character you put into play using ambush this phase by 1. That character claims 1 power when it comes into play and until the end of the phase, it gains a [Naval] enhancement on its [Power] icon, if able.

name: Great Pyramid
text:
Limited.
Marshalling: Kneel Great Pyramid to lower the cost of the next House Targaryen character you play this phase by 2.

name: Great Pyramid
text:
Limited
Marhalling: Kneel to lower the cost of the next Targaryen character you play this phase by 2.

name: Great Pyramid of Meereen
text:
Limited.
Marshalling: Kneel Great Pyramid of Meereen to lower the cost of the next [Targaryen] character you play this phase by 2.
[+2 Influence]

name: House of Shadows
text: Response: After a character's STR is lowered by a card effect, kneel a Learned character to give that character -1 STR until the end of the phase.

name: Lady Daenerys's Chambers
text: Response: After you play a House Targaryen character, return an attachment with printed cost equal to or lower than that character from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Meraxes
text:
House Targaryen Only.
Meraxes counts as 4 STR during the dominance phase.
Dominance: Kneel Meraxes to draw 1 card. Then, each opponent who did not attack you this round draws 1 card.

name: Pentos
text:
Lower the cost of the first out-of-House [Targaryen] card you play each round by 1.
Lower the cost of the first Army character you play each round by 1.
[+1 Influence]

name: Plaza of Pride
text:
House Targaryen only.
Challenges: Kneel Plaza of Pride to give an attacking Targaryen Army character you control either Stealth or Deadly until the end of the phase.

name: Slaver's Bay
text: Response: If it is Summer, after you win a [Power] challenge, kneel Slaver's Bay to put a non-unique character from any opponent's discard pile into play under your control.

name: Summer Encampment
text: Any phase: If it is Summer, kneel Summer Encampment to return a character you control to its owner's hand.

name: The Womb of the World
text: Response: After you win dominance, kneel The Womb of the World to return a non-unique Dothraki character from your dead pile to your hand.

name: Aegon's Hill
text: Challenges: Kneel Aegon's Hill to look at an opponent's hand. You may choose one character card in that hand and place it in its owner's dead pile.

name: Flaming-Pitch Tower
text: Limited Response: After you win a challenge by 4 or more total STR, kneel Flaming-Pitch Tower to choose a character without attachments. Until the end of the phase, that character gets -4 STR and is killed if its STR is 0. (Limit 1 Limited Response per round.)

name: Scorched Earth
text:
No attachments.
Non-Army characters do not count their STR during the first challenge initiated each round.

name: The Dragonpit
text:
House Targaryen only.
If you have at least 1 card in Shadows, any characters controlled by opponents who do not have more cards in Shadows than you do get -1 STR.

name: Vaes Dothrak
text:
No attachments.
Response: After you win a Military challenge in which at least 1 Dothraki character attacked, kneel Vaes Dothrak to (choose one): draw 1 card, discard 1 card at random from the losing opponent's hand, or move 1 power from the losing opponent's House to your own.

name: Rhaenys's Hill
text:
House Targaryen only.
Any Phase: Kneel and discard Rhaenys's Hill from play to put all characters in a single opponent's dead pile into play under your control until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, return those characters to their owner's dead pile.

name: Across the Summer Sea
text:
House Targaryen only.
If you have more than 1 opponent, challenges cannot be initiated by you or against you.

name: Fury of the Dragon
text: After you win a Power challenge against an opponent with a House Baratheon or a House Greyjoy House card, choose a character controlled by that opponent, and reduce its STR to 0 until the end of the round.

name: Mad King's Legacy
text:
House Targaryen only.
When revealed, choose and discard an attachment from play, if able.

name: Selmy's Scheme
text:
House Targaryen only.
During [Power] challenges your Army characters gain renown.
